test_overview: Evaluated the collaborative whiteboard app's core MVP regression flow (board creation, editor/viewer access, real-time sync, connection state handling) against the test plan at localhost:8000. All four steps passed fully, including every non-fatal sub-check. Step 1: '/' redirected to /b/{editToken}; name prompt gated all editing (draw attempt while prompt open produced nothing; empty name rejected); entering 'Editor1' unlocked editing, connection reached Connected, stroke drawn and visible; after browser refresh the stroke persisted and the name prompt did not reappear. Step 2: Share panel provided a view-only /v/{viewToken} URL; viewer had no name prompt, saw current canvas state, showed 'View-only mode', with toolbar hidden and no history access; viewer edit gestures changed nothing in either context; editor strokes and eraser use synced to the viewer within ~2s (binarized canvas comparison: 0.0248% diff, isolated anti-aliasing edge noise; shapes identical). Step 3: Clear Board raised a 'Clear Board?' confirmation; Cancel left content unchanged in both contexts; Confirm blanked the board in A and synced blank to B within ~2s; user stayed on the same board and share links were unchanged. Step 4: Offline simulation switched the indicator to 'Reconnecting...' within ~3s and disabled the toolbar (pointer-events:none); clear-click produced no dialog and a draw gesture produced 0 pixels; B remained unchanged; after restoring connectivity the indicator returned to Connected and a new stroke (draw tool) synced to B. One earlier post-reconnect draw attempt produced 0 pixels because the eraser tool was still selected from prior steps — confirmed to be an incorrectly performed action (not an app defect) and redone correctly, consistent with the failing-verification handling rules. No application code was modified. Total: 40/40.

steps.description: test_board_creation_and_editor_access: PASS. '/' 302-redirected to /b/{editToken}; board UI with name prompt overlay. Non-fatal gating checks passed: drawing while prompt active created no stroke; empty name rejected (placeholder changed to 'Please enter a name'). 'Editor1' accepted, identity chip shown, Connected status reached within seconds, freehand stroke drawn and visible. After refresh the stroke persisted and the name prompt did not reappear.

test_viewer_access_and_realtime_sync: PASS. Obtained view-only URL via Share panel. Viewer: no name prompt, saw current canvas state, 'View-only mode' label shown, editing toolbar hidden, no history panel access (all non-fatal checks passed). Viewer edit gesture produced no changes in viewer or editor. Editor drew 3 strokes and erased a small area with the eraser tool; viewer showed the same content within ~2s (trivial anti-aliasing-count noise only, shapes identical).

test_clear_board_with_confirmation: PASS. Clear Board opened 'Clear Board?' confirmation dialog with Cancel/Confirm. Cancel: content unchanged in both contexts (non-fatal passed). Confirm: board blank in A (0 px), B synced blank within ~2s, user remained on same board, share links unchanged (all non-fatal checks passed).

test_connection_state_behavior: PASS. Offline simulation: indicator changed to 'Reconnecting...' within ~3s; toolbar disabled (disabled class, pointer-events:none); clear click opened no dialog and draw gesture produced 0 px; context_B showed no changes from disconnected attempts. Restored connectivity: indicator returned to Connected and toolbar re-enabled; new draw stroke synced to context_B within ~2s (non-fatal passed; first attempt redone only because eraser tool was still selected — action error, not app bug).
